_doc: Sign-posted speed limits where they differ, or may differ, from the limit the map uses (an ordinance or resolution not yet signed, or a dated sign photo).

posted_mph: the limit on the signs as last evidenced (null = no sign evidence, see posted_evidence). bbox [S,W,N,E] + osm_name pick the stretch's segments by geometry (segment midpoint), independent of labels.
label: the source-label fragment the map data and the app's CAU list use for this stretch.
map_uses_posted: scripts/overrides.py builds this stretch at posted_mph until new_signs_confirmed is true, then at lowered_to_mph.

Guard (scripts/check_posted_limits.py, tests/test_posted_limits.py): while new_signs_confirmed is false and posted_mph is above the region's LSV cap, every segment of the stretch must be shown not LSV-legal, whatever any caution, note or override says. Every CAU caution in public/app.js must map to an entry here.

To lift a block: set new_signs_confirmed true and signs_evidence to a dated photo or notice of the new signs, run python3 scripts/build_data.py, delete the stretch's BLK line in public/app.js (tests/test_posted_limits.py names any stale one).
